name: smoke_test
title: Synthetic smoke-test set (fictional entities)
description: 24 hand-written questions over 8 short fictional documents (18 answerable, 6 deliberately unanswerable). Entities are invented so answers cannot come from a model's memorised knowledge. Used to verify that the pipeline works end to end. It is NOT a recognised research benchmark and results on it must not be reported as such.
source: Written for this project by the developer (Rabbuni, RcubiX Technologies).
answer_matching: normalised alias containment and exact match (SQuAD-style normalisation)
